meaning: Counts are reference rows, not every executable function in every Strudel build. The original names remain searchable as aliases.
sourceReview: Current public live code and documentation inspected; exact artifact hashes retained in research evidence. No reliable live release number was exposed.

publishedTests.scope: Pure-pattern event values and timing only. No scheduler, audio, current-live runtime, drawing, browser callbacks or hardware test.

remainingLimits: No blanket completeness guarantee across optional packages, generated families and future builds.
Documentation, exported names and runnable functions are not interchangeable sets.
Some entries intentionally provide no runnable example because dependencies or safe semantics were not established.
Source-reviewed log2 and degradeByWith differ from the tested published package; read their entry notes.
downstreamCorrections: angle example now supplies r for radial placement; angle is not rotation.
speak note describes cancellation/replacement rather than a speech queue.
